From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Lee <erin.greenhouse@greenhouse.io>, Ana Torres <ana@sterlingcheck.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenhouse & Background Check Renewals — phased vendor plan

Team —

Quick note to get ahead of the Q1 renewals: Greenhouse and our current background-check provider (Sterling) both come up for renewal in Feb/March. We also have a Cornerstone LMS renewal window in April that overlaps reporting and SSO work.

I propose a phased approach so we don’t rip the Band-Aid on all three at once:
- Phase 1 (Jan–Feb): Lock Greenhouse commercial terms and confirm seat counts.
- Phase 2 (Feb–Mar): Finalize background-check SOW and data-retention SLA.
- Phase 3 (Mar–Apr): LMS renewal + SSO rollout (coordinate with infra).

Primary asks:
1) Can Monica/Laura/Marcus join a 30-min stakeholder sync next week to align budget & owners?
2) Monica: can you run a quick headcount delta so we can rightsizes seats?
3) Marcus: please capture SSO gaps (SP-initiated vs IdP scoping) — I want ownership noted.

Attached: cost-comparison-2027.xlsx, SOW-draft-Greenhouse.pdf (draft, please do not share externally).

If that plan looks sensible I’ll loop in procurement and legal for an accelerated timeline.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Talent Ops | Redwood Inference
vivk.kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: cost-comparison-2027.xlsx; SOW-draft-Greenhouse.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenhouse & Background Check Renewals — phased vendor plan

Vivek — thanks for the outline. I’m available for a 30-min sync next Tue (11/23) between 10–12 PT or Wed morning. I’ll pull current seat utilization and note candidates in flight that will affect counts.

Two priorities from my side:
- Data export/retention: Sterling’s default window is shorter than our compliance ask. We need options and a per-record retention cost.
- Contracting cadence: if Greenhouse needs an MSA update we should run that in parallel to avoid separate redlines.

I’ll prepare a short slide with seat delta, active reqs, and expected hires for Q1. Marcus — can you confirm SSO contact and whether there’s budget for a consultant if we need to accelerate?

—Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: summary-template.xlsx (internal)

Hi Vivek/Monica — great to see this early. I’m available 11/23 10:30am PT for a 30-min sync — that works for us. Initial thoughts from Greenhouse: we can provide a 10% multi-year discount if you commit to a 24-month term and consolidate seat tiers. We’ll also include a pilot for interview scorecards at no additional charge to validate rollout.

I attached a short pricing summary and a redline-ready SOW if you want to start legal review (Greenhouse-pricing-quote.pdf). Also happy to join the SSO discussion — we recently shipped SAML 2.0 updates that reduce IdP work.

Erin Lee
